end.summary:
Aryan understood how endpoints distinguish a point, segment, line and ray, including that a line drawing shows only part of the full line.
Aryan understood naming segments, lines and rays with letters and that ray AB starts at A.
Aryan practised identifying ray direction using the starting letter and number direction.
Aryan practised counting segments joining points; this was partly correct and needs checking again next time.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised distinguishing geometric figures by their endpoints and naming rays, including the fact that ray AB starts at A. They used the arrowheads and starting letter to reason about a line and a ray. Counting all segments joining points was partly correct and is still to be checked again; at home, practise counting the pairs of points in small diagrams, listing each pair once.
